title: Leading Transformation
curriculumStatus: 2026 curriculum; teaching materials, access, and delivery are agreed with each cohort.

modules.title: Transformation and the five worlds
modules.focus: Read a live transformation challenge through leadership, citizens, services, management, and learning.

modules.title: Purpose, outcomes, and useful measures
modules.focus: Agree purpose, distinguish outputs from outcomes, and choose measures that help people act.

modules.title: Your practice as a transformation agent
modules.focus: Contract for useful work, examine your own contribution, and start a live practice challenge.

modules.title: Power, responsibility, and distributed leadership
modules.focus: Work with power, accountability, and distributed leadership; introduce the Four Dynamics.

modules.title: Honest, productive conversations
modules.focus: Practise listening, productive challenge, difficult conversations, and clear agreements.

modules.title: Systems inquiry, mapping, and method choice
modules.focus: Frame a useful inquiry, map different perspectives, and choose methods for the situation.

modules.title: Citizen insight and behaviour in context
modules.focus: Gather citizen insight and examine behaviour in its social and practical context.

modules.title: Strengths, community, and co-production
modules.focus: Work with strengths, community assets, co-production, and Positive Deviance.

modules.title: Demand, access, and prevention
modules.focus: Understand demand, access, avoidable work, and opportunities for prevention.

modules.title: Relational public services
modules.focus: Organise around people’s lives, relationships, and needs that cross service boundaries.

modules.title: Designing services and the work behind them
modules.focus: Connect the citizen’s experience with service design, processes, and the work behind them.

modules.title: Prototyping and learning through action
modules.focus: Test service ideas through prototypes and small experiments, then use what happens to improve them.

modules.title: Lean, flow, and operational learning
modules.focus: Apply lean, flow, A3 inquiry, and operational tools with respect for the people doing the work.

modules.title: Resource Optimisation and choices about work
modules.focus: Make effort and capacity visible, and use Resource Optimisation and Seven Ways to examine choices.

modules.title: Costs, benefits, and business cases
modules.focus: Connect activity, costs, benefits, and options in a defensible business case.

modules.title: Digital, data, and AI judgement
modules.focus: Judge digital, data, and AI proposals against service purpose, evidence, and human responsibility.

modules.title: Understanding and designing viable organisations
modules.focus: Use the Viable System Model to examine autonomy, coordination, and organisational viability.

modules.title: The Four Dynamics, roles, and organisation design
modules.focus: Apply the Four Dynamics to roles, relationships, authority, and organisation design.

modules.title: Culture, change, and meeting the other
modules.focus: Work with culture, assumptions, identity, and encounters with people who see things differently.

modules.title: Convening across communities and organisations
modules.focus: Build the relationships and conditions for action across communities and organisations.

modules.title: Strategy, commissioning, and choices about provision
modules.focus: Use Patterns of Strategy, commissioning, and provision choices to connect intent with action.

modules.title: Facilitating groups and designing interventions
modules.focus: Choose and facilitate group processes, and design interventions that fit their setting.

modules.title: Delivering, embedding, and evaluating change
modules.focus: Plan delivery, use Appreciative Inquiry and Breaking the Shell, and evaluate and embed change.

modules.title: Integration, simulation, and the next hundred days
modules.focus: Bring the repertoire together through simulation and a substantial hundred-day follow-through.

toolshed.title: The RedQuadrant Tool Shed
toolshed.meetings: Two online meetings a month, each lasting 90 minutes
toolshed.duration: Cohorts typically work together for twelve months
toolshed.availability: Dates, materials, fees, and access arrangements are agreed before joining.
toolshed.accreditation: Accredited by the Public Service Transformation Academy

psta.title: Leading Transformation through the PSTA

fee.unit: person for a three- or four-module learning package

psta.support: Each package includes a one-to-one support session with Benjamin Taylor, email support, and online questions and answers.
psta.organisationalDelivery: A full organisational programme combines modules and facilitated support to suit the team; design, faculty, commitment, and fee are agreed before booking.
psta.accreditation: Accredited by the Public Service Transformation Academy
